method: Sealed baseline plus all changed Git-blob deltas, same UTF-8/nonblank/comment/exclusion/category rules; deleted files use sealed per-blob counts; no full rescan.
limits: Approximate source size, not language-aware SLOC or coverage/runtime qualification. Explicitly retired main Web suites and duplicate mirror copies are accounted by exact path/blob manifests; canonical backend tests/support/data remain. Archived source operands are nonexecuted qualification data excluded under the original .txt rule and disclosed separately, not destroyed bytes.
